verdict.rationale: Kit documents two V4 authentication mechanisms: account-level API keys and OAuth 2.0 for App Store apps, along with refresh, PKCE and revocation flows. Nothing in the evidence describes scoped, permission-limited or read-only credentials that would let an agent or contractor read analytics without being able to send broadcasts. OAuth and token revocation are adjacent auth features and do not establish least-privilege scoping, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
